purpose: Teach: 未解決/裏切る/見せかけ/煽る/争わ/退け/減らさ/鈍い

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、未解決の難病、研究は続けています。
lines.en: Ren, we're continuing research on unresolved rare diseases.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Direct eye contact. Professional warmth without performance. Settling into the conversation with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療効果を裏切る症例、悲しいですね。
lines.en: It's sad when cases show the treatment doesn't deliver what it promised.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft concern underneath the observation. Leaning slightly forward — genuinely interested in her perspective, not just testing his knowledge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。改善を見せかける薬、患者のリスクになります。
lines.en: Yes. When drugs mask improvement instead of creating it, that becomes a real risk for patients.
lines.style: Steady, clarifying tone. A doctor explaining to someone she respects. No condescension — the rhythm of someone who has explained this carefully many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ネットで不安を煽る情報、医療現場でも対応していますね。
lines.en: And there's so much online information that stokes anxiety — we're dealing with that in medical practice too.
lines.style: Slight nod of recognition. Calm acknowledgment of a shared problem. Breath space on the dash — letting him know she understands the weight of what he's naming.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者と争わずに、納得を得る対話、心がけます。
lines.en: Yes. I try to have real conversations with patients where we reach understanding together, not argument.
lines.style: Softer now. Speaking from principle, not protocol. A small smile behind the words — the conviction of someone who chooses compassion in a demanding field.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 代替療法、効果を退ける論文、多いんですよね。
lines.en: There are quite a few studies showing alternative therapies don't actually deliver the benefits claimed.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but not dismissive. The tone of someone sharing data she finds important. Slight emphasis on 'quite a few' — evidence-backed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。リスクを減らさず、副作用、注視します。
lines.en: Yes. I keep a careful eye on side-effects especially, since we're not reducing the underlying risks.
lines.style: Precise, careful cadence. Each phrase weighted equally. The voice of someone whose attention to detail keeps people safe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感覚が鈍い高齢者、特に配慮、必要ですね。
lines.en: Elderly patients with dulled sensation need special attention — that's something we can't overlook.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on 'can't overlook.' Thoughtful, almost reflective close. A note of resolve beneath the observation — this matters to her practice.
